description: This file contains a suite of automated test cases for the Playwright library, specifically testing the 'exposeFunction' and 'exposeBinding' features on page objects, including their behavior across navigation, frames, error handling, serialization, handles, and concurrency.

methods.name: exposeBinding should work @smoke
methods.description: Tests that exposeBinding can be used to expose functions that are callable from the page context.

methods.name: should work
methods.description: Verifies that exposeFunction exposes a function that can be called from evaluate.

methods.name: should work with handles and complex objects
methods.description: Tests exposing functions that return object handles and complex objects.

methods.name: should throw exception in page context
methods.description: Checks error propagation from exposed functions that throw errors in page context.

methods.name: should support throwing "null"
methods.description: Ensures that throwing null in an exposed function is handled correctly.

methods.name: should be callable from-inside addInitScript
methods.description: Verifies that exposed functions can be called from scripts added during page initialization.

methods.name: should survive navigation
methods.description: Tests that exposed functions continue to work after page navigation.

methods.name: should await returned promise
methods.description: Ensures that functions returning promises are correctly awaited.

methods.name: should work on frames
methods.description: Checks that exposed functions are accessible within iframe contexts.

methods.name: should work on frames before navigation
methods.description: Verifies functionality within frames prior to navigation.

methods.name: should work after cross origin navigation
methods.description: Tests exposed functions across cross-origin navigations.

methods.name: should work with complex objects
methods.description: Verifies serialized complex objects are correctly passed.

methods.name: exposeBindingHandle should work
methods.description: Tests exposing binding functions that return element handles, verifying handle evaluation.

methods.name: exposeBindingHandle should not throw during navigation
methods.description: Ensures stable operation of handle-based exposeBinding during navigation.

methods.name: should throw for duplicate registrations
methods.description: Checks that attempting to register a duplicate function throws an error.

methods.name: exposeBindingHandle should throw for multiple arguments
methods.description: Verifies that improper usage with multiple arguments throws an error.

methods.name: exposeBinding(handle) should work with element handles
methods.description: Tests exposing element handles and invoking them from page scripts.

methods.name: should work with setContent
methods.description: Validates that exposed functions work correctly when page content is set dynamically.

methods.name: should alias Window, Document and Node
methods.description: Checks that exposed functions can handle references like window, document, and node.

methods.name: should serialize cycles
methods.description: Ensures objects with cyclic references can be serialized and passed.

methods.name: should work with overridden console object
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the console object is overridden to null.

methods.name: should work with busted Array.prototype.map/push
methods.description: Tests exposure of functions when Array prototypes are tampered with.

methods.name: should fail with busted Array.prototype.toJSON
methods.description: Ensures error is thrown if JSON serialization of Array.prototype is broken.

methods.name: exposeBinding should work in parallel
methods.description: Checks concurrent registration of multiple bindings.

ctags.name: promise
ctags.pattern: /^  const promise = new Promise(f => cb = f);$/

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^  const result = await page.evaluate(async () => window['complexObject']({ x: 5 }, { x: 2 }));$/
